goal: Reject transaction recipient amounts above MAX_MONEY before coin selection begins
Prevent node assertion crashes and overflow wrap-arounds when funding invalid outputs
agreement: Support as a useful sanity check and cleaner sanitizer behavior (maflcko)
Loop refactoring suggestions were incorporated and squashed (furszy, maflcko)
Suggested author close multiple open submissions to focus review effort (pinheadmz)
